Tune in to this melodious song Aa Tu Aa Zara from the movie Phoolon Ki Sej (1964) starring Mehmood & Shobha Khote..
Song: Aa Tu Aa Zara Dil Me Aa
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar, Mukesh
Music: P. Adinarayana Rao
Lyrics: Hasrat Jaipuri
Movie: Phoolon Ki Sej
Cast: Vyjayanthimala, Manoj Kumar
Director: Inder Raj Anand
